name: io.github.QuackbackIO/quackback
description: Open-source feedback and support platform: feedback, conversations, tickets, changelog, help center.

host.description: Hostname of your Quackback instance (e.g., feedback.yourcompany.com)

tools.name: create_changelog
tools.description: Create a changelog entry

tools.name: update_changelog
tools.description: Update title, content, publish state, and/or linked posts on an existing changelog entry

tools.name: delete_changelog
tools.description: Soft-delete a changelog entry

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a feedback post

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Edit a comment's content

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Hard-delete a comment and all its replies (cascade)

tools.name: react_to_comment
tools.description: Add or remove an emoji reaction on a comment

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List support-inbox conversations, newest activity first

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Get a conversation and its most recent messages

tools.name: reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Send an agent reply in a conversation (visible to the visitor)

tools.name: suggest_post
tools.description: Suggest to the SUPPORT TEAM (not the visitor) that a RESOLVED conversation be tracked as a feedback post

tools.name: share_post
tools.description: Embed an EXISTING feedback post as a card in the conversation so the visitor can view and upvote it

tools.name: set_conversation_status
tools.description: Change a conversation's status (open, snoozed, or closed)

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file (base64-encoded, max 5 MB decoded) so it can be attached to a conversation reply, ticket reply, or ticket note

tools.name: create_article
tools.description: Create a new help center article (draft)

tools.name: update_article
tools.description: Update a help center article

tools.name: delete_article
tools.description: Soft-delete a help center article

tools.name: manage_category
tools.description: Create, update, or delete a help center category

tools.name: triage_post
tools.description: Update a post: set status, tags, and/or owner

tools.name: vote_post
tools.description: Toggle vote on a feedback post

tools.name: proxy_vote
tools.description: Add or remove a vote on behalf of another user

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Submit new feedback on a board

tools.name: merge_post
tools.description: Merge a duplicate post into a canonical post

tools.name: unmerge_post
tools.description: Restore a merged post to independent state

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Soft-delete a feedback post

tools.name: restore_post
tools.description: Restore a soft-deleted post

tools.name: get_post_activity
tools.description: Get the activity log for a post

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search feedback posts, changelog entries, or help center articles

tools.name: get_details
tools.description: Get full details for any entity by TypeID

tools.name: accept_suggestion
tools.description: Accept a post-to-post merge suggestion, merging the source post into the target

tools.name: dismiss_suggestion
tools.description: Dismiss a merge suggestion

tools.name: restore_suggestion
tools.description: Restore a dismissed merge suggestion back to pending status

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List support tickets

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Get a ticket and its most recent thread messages, oldest-first

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Open a support ticket

tools.name: reply_to_ticket
tools.description: Post a reply on a ticket thread (visible to the requester)

tools.name: add_ticket_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a ticket thread

tools.name: link_ticket
tools.description: Link a customer ticket to a tracker so the tracker's stage changes cascade onto it

tools.name: unlink_ticket
tools.description: Remove a customer ticket from a tracker

tools.name: widget_install_status
tools.description: Read whether the Quackback widget is connected on the customer site
